functions.name: Cursor
functions.docs:
Respond with a specific cursor.
This cursor will be used and no other widgets will be asked.

functions.name: GetCursorWindow
functions.docs: @return The window to render the Cursor Widget in.

functions.name: GetCursorWidget
functions.docs: @return The custom Cursor Widget to render if set and the event was handled.

functions.name: GetCursorType
functions.docs: @return The requested MouseCursor if no custom widget is set and the event was handled.

functions.name: SetCursorWidget
functions.signature: SetCursorWidget(Target, In Cursor Window, In Cursor Widget)
functions.docs: Set the Cursor Widget, used by slate application to set the cursor widget if the MapCursor returns a widget.
